override.reason: The tooltip wraps: 'Defense Penetration: 10' / 'Magic Defense Penetration:' / '10'. The label and its value are on separate lines, so the value read as a bare '10' with no stat and the magic penetration was lost entirely. Confirmed by the project owner as Magic Defense Penetration +10. Left to the parser this would mean treating an orphaned number as belonging to the label above it, which is the same shape as a continuation clause ('Extra 1% per refine') but means something different -- so it is corrected here rather than guessed at.

override.reason: The tooltip writes 'Skull Mask Set:' over 'Critical Damage +10% / while wearing Skull Mask', which is a condition on this weapon, not a set -- so the parser invented a one-member 'Skull Mask' set and hung the bonus on it. The set is dropped under the 'skull-mask' key and the bonus is restored here as a condition, in the same shape the Bullhorn pieces use. The effects are restated too, because 'Backstab can land Critical hits' was wrapped across two lines and read as two separate unparsed effects.

patch_notes: Bargain Hunter's Catalogue no longer crashes with "hide searches" on. Typing filters the list already loaded, "Items: N" follows the filter, Next respects the filtered pages, and the "Searches left" text no longer shows in that mode.

Bargain Hunter's Catalogue now list every vending shop in Alberta at once and filter as you type. The list refreshes every 2 seconds and everyone reads from the same snapshot, so it stays light on the server.

'Full Shadow Card Set' is a set heading written without a colon, so the parser read the three lines under it as this card's own and the card claimed the whole set bonus on its own. Those lines are moved to the 'full-shadow-card' set, which needs all six Rank shadow cards compounded; what is left here is the card's own ATK/MATK.

name: Amatsu Takuhon
description:
A sheet of blank washi, taken from a stack someone left behind
in a ruin that no longer has weather.

A takuhon is paper pressed to carved stone, with ink
drawn across it. The cut comes away pale; the rest comes away dark.

Use it to read again the lines you have carried out of the ruin.

name: Ink Table
description:
Your finished takuhon, hardened into a grinding stone.

Use it to raise your forge where you stand.
Costs 1,000,000z. The forge stands for 10 minutes.
Anyone may engrave there. You keep 25% of what they pay.

Grind Pine Soot in to engrave more seals.
2 seals: 100 Pine Soot
3 seals: 500 Pine Soot
4 seals: 2,500 Pine Soot + 5 Enenra Soot
